candidate_decisions.reason: The exact 18:99 and 18:100 anchors support a distinct sequence in which intermingling is gathered before Hell is presented. The focus presentation branch and both attributed context branches land through explicit carrier, trigger, and focus-return refs.

The exact relative description in 18:101 supplies independent sight, covering, remembrance, and hearing triggers for the focus display. The sensory reversal remains a distinct qualified contextual reading and every supplied branch is landed.

The repeated نزلا wording in the exact 18:102 and 18:107 anchors, together with the shelter, permanence, and no-transfer details in 18:107-108, creates a specific assigned-reception relation beyond a generic punishment theme. The legacy-unbound trace is retained with attribution and all seven branches land.

The exact pericope sequence links works, loss, valuation, weight, and recompense to the focus display. This is a distinct countervalue mechanism rather than a restatement that Hell is a consequence, and all five branches are explicitly activated.

The focus presentation is connected by exact 18:106 evidence to rejected signs, messengers, and mockery. The terminal-exhibit reading has a distinct communication mechanism and retains the live alternative that the relation may be causal rather than a mode reversal.

The exploratory outlier has an exact repeated focus carrier, an exact 18:109 trigger surface, and a stated containment boundary that keeps display primary. It is retained as a bounded spatial echo rather than suppressed for being peripheral.

The exploratory outlier has an exact focus return through the directional-display branch and an exact 18:110 contextual trace. It survives only as an attributed flame-front echo with the supplied warning that the hope word is not being given a flame gloss.

findings.title: Gathering before exposure
findings.claim: The focus ayah presents Hell to a deliberately assembled audience: the turbulence of 18:99 is gathered into one totality before the display in 18:100.
findings.mechanism: The repeated focus form carries a presentation to sight, while the independent triggers in 18:99 move from intermingling to emphatic gathering. Their contact makes the focus display read as staged exposure of a gathered audience.
findings.reader_payoff: The recipients become a body brought together for the sight, so the display is newly perceptible as an arranged encounter rather than only an event affecting a plural class.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading remains that Hell is shown to the deniers on that day. The gathering is a qualified staging inference; the adjacent clauses may also be read as consecutive resurrection events without this audience emphasis.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus and context Arabic and the anchored trace support the contact, while the HFT reader identity is legacy-unbound and the supplied context lacks target morphology.

branch_activations.activation: The focus display supplies the independent operation that turns the attributed gathering into a staged audience relation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The gathered totality is positioned as the audience for the display.
branch_activations.boundary: No more specific lexical gloss or facet is claimed because this context branch is unresolved in the packet.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The displayed audience is formed from a turbulent, intermingled mass.
branch_activations.boundary: The packet supports the attributed turbulence-to-display sequence, not a claim that the focus word itself means turbulence.

findings.title: A display after covered reception
findings.claim: The focus display is framed as an unavoidable visual address to people whose sight and hearing had been closed to remembrance.
findings.mechanism: The focus presents Hell, and the independent relative description in 18:101 supplies eyes under a cover, distance from remembrance, and unavailable hearing. Those sensory contacts turn the display into a direct address through the channel that remains visibly exposed.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive why the presentation is more than a generic announcement of punishment: it answers a prior failure of sight, remembrance, and hearing with an object made immediately present.
findings.containment: Hell remains literally displayed to the deniers. The sensory reversal is a qualified contextual inference; 18:101 may characterize the recipients without assigning a corrective purpose to the display.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus and 18:101 Arabic surfaces provide the sensory sequence and the HFT trace names the focus return, but the reader identity and target morphology remain unbound.

branch_activations.carrier: The remembrance word in 18:101 carries the content from which the recipients are turned away.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus makes Hell visible to those recipients.
branch_activations.activation: The displayed object meets the stated distance from remembrance and gives the sensory reversal its contextual direction.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The display confronts people who had not received remembrance through their inward recall.
branch_activations.boundary: No unresolved branch gloss or stronger claim about the psychology of remembrance is supplied.

branch_activations.carrier: The hearing word in 18:101 carries literal sound reception that the recipients cannot access.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus uses visible presentation as its governing act.
branch_activations.activation: The unavailable hearing channel makes the focus presentation stand out as an unavoidable visual address.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: What did not enter by hearing is met by a sight that is placed before them.
branch_activations.boundary: The packet does not establish that every warning was auditory or that the display is exclusively corrective.

findings.title: An assigned reception
findings.claim: The display opens onto an assigned reception: Hell prepared for the coverers stands in formal counterposition to the sheltered, permanent lodging prepared for believers.
findings.mechanism: The focus presentation meets the preparation and lodging wording in 18:102, while the same lodging word returns for the gardens in 18:107 and is followed by permanence and no sought transfer in 18:108. The repeated reception frame changes the display from a spectacle alone into an entrance toward an allotted destination.
findings.reader_payoff: Hell can be seen as a prepared reception within the pericope's opposed accommodations, while the ordinary display remains fully recoverable.
findings.containment: The finding does not claim that نُزُلًا has only a hospitality meaning; provision or destination remains live. The garden contrast is a bounded contextual relation, not a whole-surah thesis.

epistemic.reason: Exact Arabic supplies the repeated reception term and its local contrasts; the HFT trace is medium-confidence and legacy-unbound, with no target morphology for the context units.

branch_activations.carrier: The garden word in 18:107 carries the sheltering counterpart to exposed Hell.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus presents Hell to the coverers.
branch_activations.activation: The garden's sheltering image provides the independent counterpart that makes exposure a feature of the opposed receptions.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus display is colored as the exposed side of a protected-versus-exposed reception contrast.
branch_activations.boundary: The context branch is unresolved and no additional garden image is imported beyond the supplied carrier.

branch_activations.activation: The no-transfer statement gives the positive reception a settled destination against which the focus reception can be read as assigned.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The two receptions are presented as destinations rather than interchangeable scenes.
branch_activations.boundary: No claim is made that the unresolved branch supplies an independent doctrine of permanence.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The display points toward an assigned and enduring reception contrast.
branch_activations.boundary: The attributed branch is retained without an invented lexicon gloss or facet.

findings.title: A countervalue after audit
findings.claim: Within the focus display, Hell can be read as the countervalue revealed when the recipients' self-approved works are tested and found without weight.
findings.mechanism: The focus presentation meets the pericope's sequence of commercial loss, valuation, absent weight, and recompense. The commodity facet of the repeated focus root therefore lets Hell function as the displayed return after the works fail the imposed measure.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the display as connected to an audit of apparently successful works: the issue is not only that Hell follows disbelief, but that the works are brought to a measure and return no weight.
findings.containment: The visual presentation remains the ordinary focus act, and the commercial reading remains a contextual resonance. The packet also leaves open that the commodity branch is lexical color without a full exchange scene.

epistemic.reason: The exact anchors provide the loss, valuation, weight, and recompense sequence; the HFT trace is legacy-unbound and its context morphology is not supplied.

branch_activations.activation: The recompense meets the focus display and turns the displayed object into the returned countervalue of the audit sequence.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Hell is presented as the answer brought forward after the works are assessed.
branch_activations.boundary: No unresolved branch gloss or independent legal theory of recompense is supplied.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The recipients approach the displayed Hell through a failed-return image.
branch_activations.boundary: The context branch is unresolved and is not treated as a replacement for the ordinary theological statement.

findings.title: The warning becomes its own exhibit
findings.claim: Hell is shown as the terminal form of a rejected warning: signs and messengers once met with mockery culminate in the referent itself being exhibited.
findings.mechanism: The focus uses direct presentation, while 18:106 names rejected signs, messengers, and mockery. Their contact permits a shift from mediated warning to an immediate exhibit whose referent is placed before the recipients.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see what changes in the act of display: the warning is no longer only carried by a sign or messenger but is encountered as the displayed thing itself.
findings.containment: Hell remains the recompense named by the pericope, and the communication-mode reversal is an attributed contextual inference. The relation may also be read simply as punishment following mockery, which remains live.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus and 18:106 surfaces support presentation, signs, messengers, and mockery; the HFT trace is legacy-unbound and explicitly preserves a causal alternative.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The sign's referent is now encountered directly as Hell on display.

findings.title: A bounded breadth echo
findings.claim: The repeated focus form also permits a bounded spatial echo: a field of display can flicker as breadth against the later sea-and-ink image of extension that runs out.
findings.mechanism: The focus occurrences carry the accepted breadth branch, and 18:109 independently supplies the sea's spread, lengthening extension, and exhaustion. Their contact activates a subordinate width-versus-length image without displacing the act of presentation.
findings.reader_payoff: The emphatic repetition can be heard as giving the displayed field a lateral reach, while the later image supplies the scale and limit pressure that make that spatial echo perceptible.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory spatial echo. It must not translate عرضًا as width, and it does not claim that the focus verb loses its ordinary display meaning or that the sea analogy describes Hell directly.

epistemic.reason: The outlier is explicitly exploratory and rests on an exact repeated focus carrier plus an exact 18:109 trace; the HFT source is legacy-unbound and target morphology is absent.

findings.title: A tentative flame-front echo
findings.claim: A very tentative cross-root echo lets the displayed Hell appear as a flame-front at the edge of the hoped-for meeting, while the ordinary hope sense remains in place.
findings.mechanism: The accepted directional-display facet makes Hell an apparition entering the recipients' field, and the attributed 18:110 trace contributes flame imagery through a non-dominant split-root target. Their contact specifies the front's color without redefining the hope word.
findings.reader_payoff: The displayed object can be sensed as a front approaching the horizon of the anticipated meeting, adding a faint visual temperature to an otherwise unspecified apparition.
findings.containment: This remains exploratory and attributed. The hope word is not given a flame gloss, the focus display remains primary, and the packet does not establish an independent lexicon branch for the split-root context target.

epistemic.reason: The outlier is explicitly exploratory, uses an exact 18:110 contact and focus return, and carries a split-root qualification with no supplied context morphology or independent branch record.

friction_notes: All seven focus word-analysis alignments are resolved; no unresolved analysis unit required qualification.

All retained candidates come from a legacy-unbound HFT trace. Exact Arabic anchors and focus returns are supplied, but target morphology for context ayat and independent lexicon records for unresolved context branches are absent; those activations remain attributed and their gloss and facet fields stay null.

The automatic host basmala 18:0 was reviewed as ordinary macro context and supplied no independent carrier-trigger contact to the focus. The explicitly added external ayat 1:2-1:7 were reviewed in phase 2; they add no specific focus contact or changed reading beyond the native pericope judgment frame, so no external overlay finding was retained.

The HFT alternatives remain visible inside the findings: assembled exposure retains the separate-resurrection alternative, sensory reversal retains a descriptive-only alternative, assigned reception retains provision-or-destination, countervalue retains lexical-color-only, terminal exhibit retains a causal reading, and the two outliers remain exploratory with explicit boundaries.
